items.title: U.S. inflation, Ethereum upgrade talks: Crypto Week Ahead
items.summary: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Oct. 12.

items.title: XRP Ledger defends emergency patch for unlimited XRP bug
items.summary: The XRP Ledger Foundation pushed back against claims that its emergency security patch was forced on network operators.

items.title: Coldcard says it’s investigating how phishing link appeared on its X account
items.summary: Company advised users not to visit or interact with the link in question and said it will share any further verified updates.

items.title: XRP Ledger patched decade-old bug that could create billions of dollars in XRP from nothing
items.summary: Researchers demonstrated how a payment could create spendable XRP without the sender funding it, prompting an emergency software release.

items.title: Tokenized catastrophe bonds target the disaster-insurance gap
items.summary: A planned Bermuda issuance would put legal ownership onchain and seek capital for disaster risks that remain costly to insure.

items.title: Bitcoin pulls back from $84,000 as oil recovers, ETFs bleed over $600 million
items.summary: Bitcoin reversed early gains as oil bounced back to over $92. Analysts express concerns over large outflows from spot ETFs last week.

items.title: Global watchdog flags stablecoin risks, AI threats ahead of G20
items.summary: The Financial Stability Board flagged cross-border stablecoin risks and AI-related cybersecurity threats while urging G20 policymakers to support stronger safeguards.

items.title: One year after 10/10 flash crash, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but altcoins still face risks
items.summary: Bitcoin and ether order books are deeper than before the crash, while altcoin liquidity keeps eroding and spot trading remains well below its October 2025 peak.

items.title: Bitcoin's $19 billion wake-up call: One-year after flash crash, has crypto learned anything?
items.summary: The Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets. Traders now have better tools to spot risks, but the forces behind the selloff remain.

items.title: Bitcoin's volatility has plunged, but extreme price swings are more frequent than in 2018
items.summary: CoinDesk analysis finds 10 unusually large trading days in 2026, raising questions about how investors measure risk in an increasingly institutional crypto market.

items.title: Tech chief says EU can fend off rogue AI risk: Report
items.summary: Recent incidents at OpenAI ‌and Anthropic stoke global concerns and fears that rogue AI agents may venture beyond human control.

items.title: HSBC, Ant Digital test AI-agent payments using tokenized deposits
items.summary: The technical trial showed how AI agents could discover services and make micropayments using HSBC’s tokenized deposits, with real-time settlement and risk checks.

items.title: SequenceHash: multihashing for the rest of us
items.summary: Multihashing is one of those cryptographic tasks that’s easy not to think about too much. This is unfortunate, because multihashing is a common stumbling point when cryptographers try to use hashes. As part of our goal to “fix software, not bugs,” Trail of Bits is introducing Seq

items.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
items.summary: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

items.title: Tom Lee sees $2 trillion wealth transfer fueling crypto demand as Bitmine buys more ether
items.summary: The Bitmine chairman said he expects younger investors to drive demand for digital assets as his ether treasury company inches closer to owning 5% of the total supply.

items.title: Standard Chartered offers RLUSD custody in Dubai and plans LMAX collateral link
items.summary: Ripple previously gave LMAX $150 million in financing to integrate RLUSD into its institutional infrastructure.

items.title: Ledger claims CryptoBilis cases are limited as up to $93 million is traced, $10 million frozen
items.summary: Ledger said every confirmed case involves devices sold by the Southeast Asian reseller, but critics say the hardware-wallet maker must answer for an authorized sales channel.

items.title: Bitcoin falls below $83,000 as dollar strength keeps markets on edge
items.summary: Bitcoin and gold hold steady as a firm dollar and rising bond yields weigh on sentiment, while IREN secures a multiyear cloud services deal with Anthropic.

items.title: Global financial watchdog calls for cross-border information sharing, planning for stablecoin crisis
items.summary: Coins jointly issued by multiple companies can trap reserves in one jurisdiction while redemption demands hit another, complicating cross-border crisis response.

items.title: South Korea just got its first traditional bank loans backed by bitcoin
items.summary: Loans use third-party custodians for bitcoin holdings and rely on court-ordered sales if borrowers default.
